grade.value: ⚠ SPLIT VERDICT, and the split is the point. The CAPABILITY-TRANSFER half — that NR2F1 supplies the known-answer control the degrader program never had — is REFUTED at $0 by retrieval: no experimental NR2F1 structure exists, the agonist C26 was itself found by docking into a 40%-identity homology model with no measured binding constant, and this repository's own screen puts NR2F1 at 0.216 identity to NR4A3 with 4 of 10 Pocket-5 positions gapped. The DISEASE-FIT half — that dormancy maintenance is unusually well matched to EMC's late-recurrence natural history — is untouched and is the reason this route is registered rather than closed.

distinct_from.axis: what the molecule is asked to do to the receptor
distinct_from.why: the degrader removes NR4A3; this route AGONISES a different receptor to install a quiescence programme, and it inherits none of the ternary or ubiquitin-transfer requirements. It does inherit the same class of paralogue problem in a harder instance — the NR2F1/NR2F2 LBD pair is reported at 96% identity.

RT-RXR is closed because NR4A3 does not heterodimerise with RXR. That is a measurement about NR4A3's dimer and says nothing about NR2F1, which does heterodimerise with RXR and whose only usable LBD model is templated on RXRα. Two different receptors; the closure does not transfer.

a dependency route kills dividing cells; this route deliberately does not — its endpoint is that cells stay asleep and the tumour does not shrink. Efficacy readouts that reward shrinkage would score it as a failure.

publication.contribution: Two things the field does not have written down. First, the honest state of the NR2F1 druggability record: the most-cited dormancy agonist rests on a homology model at 40% identity with no structure and no measured binding constant, and its own authors say so. Second, a worked example of a capability-transfer proposal refuted for $0 before any compute was bought — which is the failure mode most likely to consume a small program's budget.

systems/graph/routes.json.title: NR2F1 dormancy agonism
systems/graph/routes.json.purpose: EMC's clinical problem is late recurrence rather than bulk disease. Could a therapy that maintains dormancy — rather than shrinking tumours — match that natural history, and can this program's orphan-NR-LBD machinery grade any compound that tried?
systems/graph/routes.json.rationale: EMC metastasises late, overwhelmingly to lung, over many years, with 10-year survival reported at 65–70%. A therapy that holds disseminated cells asleep and never shrinks a tumour is worth little in most cancers and is unusually well matched here. NR2F1 is the published master regulator of disseminated-tumour-cell dormancy and has a reported specific agonist, which made it look like both a target and a calibrator. It is the first; it is not the second.
remaining_unknowns: Whether NR2F1 is expressed in EMC at all — the gate on everything else, and a $0 read already dispatched.
Whether agonising NR2F1 does anything in EMC. No EMC model has been tested with C26 or any NR2F1 agonist by anyone.
Whether NR2F1 can be engaged selectively over NR2F2, whose LBD is reported at 96% identity — a harder instance of the problem that stopped the degrader route.
Whether C26 binds NR2F1 directly at all. Its reported target engagement is the knockout-dependence of a cellular effect; no Kd, SPR, ITC or thermal shift appears in the primary report.

required_validation.what: NR2F1 expression in EMC, above floor, in at least one series
A known-answer control for pose prediction in an NR2F-family LBD

readiness.why_not_higher: One half is a pending binary read and the other half is a refutation of a proposal nobody published. Neither is a paper on its own; both belong in the parked-modalities record.
missing: the NR2F1 expression read in EMC
any measured binding constant for any NR2F1 ligand

timing.rationale: The biology half resolves on a free read already in flight. The instrument half cannot move until somebody else determines an NR2F-family receptor–ligand complex, which is not this program's experiment to run and is not obviously imminent — the family's only crystal structure is from 2008 and is ligand-free.
timing.six_month_delta: Small. Structure determination on an autorepressed orphan receptor with no high-affinity ligand is not a fast-moving target.
timing.two_year_delta: Possibly material if the dormancy field's clinical interest pulls a structural effort behind it.
timing.automation_outlook: The computational half is fully automatable and already built; what is missing is an experiment, which automation does not supply.

next.best_next_action: Read the pending NR2F1 row out of emc-expression-datasets.yml. ⛔ Do NOT dispatch a second run — one is already in flight. If NR2F1 is at floor in both series, close this route on premise_false and stop; if it is expressed, the next action is still not a docking run, because there is nothing to calibrate against.

systems/graph/routes.json.display_name: Endocrine therapy in hormone-responsive-partner NR4A3 fusions

grade.value: ⛔ REAL, VERIFIED, AND IT REACHES ALMOST NOBODY — and the route's own headline must say so. One EMC patient in the world literature had a PGR::NR4A3 fusion, received tamoxifen, and at the time of report had over five years of ongoing benefit (PMID 36103645). ZERO of the partner-genotyped EMC cases in the two cohorts this repository cites carried a PGR partner; the denominator, the Wilson 95% interval and the stated non-overlap assumption are DERIVED, never typed, and live in `hormone-partner-lane.json` → `reach.pooled`. ⭐ The GENERAL principle is stronger than the EMC route: the 5' partner supplies the promoter, so the reachable handle on fusion expression is the partner's regulatory input — now supported across 12 partners and 3 tumour types, including a second oestrogen-axis partner (GREB1::NR4A3) and an enhancer-hijack case outside EMC entirely (SCPP::NR4A3 in salivary acinic cell carcinoma). ⛔ Neither adds an EMC patient.

distinct_from.axis: what is lowered, and by what mechanism
distinct_from.why: the degrader removes the fusion PROTEIN and must discriminate NR4A3 from its paralogues at the ligand-binding domain. This route lowers fusion TRANSCRIPTION by acting on the 5' partner's promoter input, and inherits no paralogue-selectivity requirement at all — the discrimination is genomic, not molecular, and is exact by construction because only the fusion allele carries that promoter driving NR4A3.

distinct_from.axis: where in the causal chain the drug acts
distinct_from.why: that route acts DOWNSTREAM of the fusion on a nuclear-receptor axis the fusion activates. This one acts UPSTREAM, on the promoter that transcribes the fusion. Opposite ends of the same chain, and a patient could in principle be eligible for both.

distinct_from.axis: which nuclear receptor and in what capacity
distinct_from.why: RT-RXR asks whether NR4A3's own dimer partner is druggable and is closed on measurement. Here PGR and GREB1 appear as GENOMIC DONORS of a promoter, not as receptors being modulated in the tumour cell — the drug acts on ER, upstream of the donor promoter.

systems/graph/routes.json.closure_note: NOT closed, and its limit is arithmetic rather than mechanistic. The mechanism is sound and the single clinical observation is strong for an n of 1; what bounds the route is the size of the eligible population, which the repository's own cited cohorts put at 0 of 84 with a ~4.4% Wilson upper bound. ⚠ That bound may UNDERCOUNT for a stated reason and it must not be inflated because of it: the source report says its own fusion 'would have not been captured by existing commercial vendors which use panel-based approaches that do not include PGR or N4A3', and both cited cohorts genotyped by targeted assay.

publication.contribution: The first partner-by-partner druggability map of the NR4A3 5' partners, with an explicit evidence tier per row and the retrieval negatives kept. Its one sentence for the field's record: because NR4A3 breaks near its start, the pharmacologically reachable handle on fusion expression is the PARTNER's regulatory input and never NR4A3's own — which is why one PGR-partnered patient responded to an anti-oestrogen, why a MEK inhibitor cannot work on any of them, and why the honest reach of a hormonal route in EMC is a bound of a few percent rather than a subtype.

systems/graph/routes.json.title: Endocrine therapy in hormone-responsive-partner NR4A3 fusions
systems/graph/routes.json.purpose: NR4A3 breaks near its own start, so the 5' partner supplies the promoter. Which partners import a druggable regulatory input, and how many EMC patients could such a route serve?
systems/graph/routes.json.rationale: A fusion oncoprotein is usually undruggable and its promoter is usually not. Here the promoter is the partner's, and partners differ: PGR's is oestrogen-driven and has a drug, GREB1's is a canonical oestrogen-receptor target, and the FET-family partners that account for the great majority of EMC have no retrieved inducible input at all. That asymmetry is the route, and it is also the route's ceiling.
remaining_unknowns: The true frequency of hormone-responsive partners in EMC. Zero events in 84 genotyped cases bounds it; it does not measure it, and both cohorts used assays the index report says would have missed its own case.
Whether anti-oestrogen therapy benefits the four reported PGR::NR4A3 uterine epithelioid leiomyosarcomas — the report that describes them does not mention endocrine treatment.
Whether the HSPA8 promoter carries a druggable inducible element. The only partner whose gene family plausibly does; nothing was retrieved either way.

Whether lowering fusion transcription is therapeutically sufficient in any partner class. No experiment addresses this for any partner, including PGR — the single clinical observation is an outcome, not a mechanism measurement.

required_validation.what: An RNA-seq-genotyped EMC series large enough to estimate the hormone-responsive-partner fraction rather than bound it

readiness.why_not_higher: The partner map and the reach bound are complete and citable now, and the field has no equivalent. What it cannot yet be is a treatment recommendation: the clinical evidence is n = 1 and the eligible population is bounded at a few percent.
missing: any outcome from a second hormone-responsive-partner case

timing.rationale: The whole route is literature and annotation. It is finished except for writing, it costs nothing, and it is the only route in the portfolio with a documented multi-year clinical benefit behind it — however small the population.
timing.six_month_delta: Small; driven by whether a second case is reported.
timing.two_year_delta: Moderate — unbiased RNA-seq is displacing panel genotyping in sarcoma, which is precisely the change that would make more of these cases visible.
timing.automation_outlook: Fully automatable; the enumeration here was produced by a regex over a retrieved corpus.

next.best_next_action: One targeted $0 Europe PMC query for outcomes in the four PGR::NR4A3 uterine epithelioid leiomyosarcomas and any GREB1::NR4A3 case. Taking the axis from n = 1 to n > 1 — in any disease — is the single observation that most changes what this route can claim.

new_ids_requiring_registration.what: An experimentally determined structure of NR2F1 or NR2F2 LBD WITH A LIGAND BOUND is deposited.
new_ids_requiring_registration.why: the only event that could make a genuine known-answer control constructible in this receptor family.
new_ids_requiring_registration.detection: $0 — an RCSB accession query, or a method-watch trigger.

new_ids_requiring_registration.what: A measured binding constant (Kd/IC50 by SPR, ITC, thermal shift or radioligand displacement) for any compound against purified NR2F1 LBD.
new_ids_requiring_registration.why: it would make C26 a known answer for an AFFINITY instrument even without a structure. ⛔ Still not for a POSE instrument.

new_ids_requiring_registration.what: An EMC series genotyped by unbiased RNA-seq rather than a targeted panel, reporting 5' partners.
new_ids_requiring_registration.why: the only observation that converts the hormonal route's reach BOUND into an estimate, in either direction.
